en.title: Optional built-in audio for Play games
en.body: Pass audio: false to play or play3d to use a game-owned mixer or run silently. Play skips its AudioContext and all preset preparation, including on the first input. Built-in audio remains enabled by default.

zh.title: Play 游戏可关闭内置音频
zh.body: 给 play 或 play3d 传入 audio: false 即可使用游戏自有混音器或静音运行。Play 会跳过内置 AudioContext 和音效预设准备，首次操作也不会触发这些工作。内置音频默认开启。
